Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Quite a few Walk of Flames (as well as Drains Essences) there, yet not THAT many presses to continue.

Remove some WoF/DE and add some more Apportations -maneuver/press = doubleplusgood.

More presses would be gained from Mob Connections, but you already are somewhat heavy with masters. Perhaps replacing one of the Poewerbases/Hunting Grounds with it?

Also with two Powerbases to temp theft by other players you have just 2 Wakes/OtQV.

Lastly, not counting Hector, plenty of bigcaps with no crypt acceleration (Info Highway, Zillah's Valley) and precious few Governs (to Govern down). Swedes would not approve

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: I think the main problem with the decks really is the combat, you have lots of second round stuff, but not really that many ways to get there, which means that apart from Hector, none of your guys can use it well. I think you would do much better if you would just ditch the second round stuff (and Hector who really isn't that good). Or then you could try to make a deck that really focuses on Hector, for like I don't know, rush and hit people with agg and graverob them or something. But whatever way to go, you need to focus the deck some, as now your trying to do too many things and because of that the deck is like all over the place.

Messages.Author: Kiddo
Messages.Body:
If you are going to base your deck around Uta, then you really should play with cards that she would get most mileage from, like Blood Fury, Blood to Water (the only non-first round card you really need), Soul Burn and Serenading the Kami.A splash of, perhaps, Skin of the Chameleon and a couple of Walk of Flames is all you need.

First of all, you don't own any Shotgun Rituals, right? Perhaps even better, because that is actually quite a crappy card...

Secondly, main problem of Drain Essence is that it does not, under any circumstances, send opposing vampires to torpor.

I've had quite successful deck based on Uta, but it was geared towards close combat, unpreventable by fortitude...in your module, if you don't have Shotgun Ritual in hand, you can't use 15 combat cards, and if you aren't on long range, you can't use further 5.

Also, what you can't but should be able to do, is get around S:CE, playing one of the following cards: Telepathic Tracking, Thoughts Betrayed.

You don't need that many enter combat cards, since this is Uta's innate ability...

There are also several issues you have to deal with and, since it is a !Tremere deck, you have almost unique solutions to those issues: a)means to get precisely the THA card you need at any time - Spirit Summoning Chamber and b)way to deal with a vampire once you do manage to torporise it - Nephandus.

Should you opt for such an angle, you really should tweak your crypt to include Antonio (to get mages) and have all other vamps have increased strength - one copy of Depravity and several copies of Biothaumaturgical Experiments are a norm. also, Frondator is also excellent - she can both rescue your vamps cheaply or can rescue famed opponents to be torporized again. While we're on the subject - where is at least a single Fame?

Lastly, i really think your intercept angle in form of all those masters is both unneeded and way to costly - if you think you need to intercept anything, use your AUS and conserve your pool.
